relationships.subject: CB2 receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: the activation of CB2R has been reported to transform microglia from the M1 to the M2 phenotype

relationships.subject: Spinal microglia
relationships.evidence_quote: microglia produce and secrete various pro-inflammatory mediators, including interleukin 1β (IL-1β), IL-6, interferon γ (IFN-γ), tumor necrosis factor α (TNF-α), and prostaglandin E2 (PGE2)

relationships.subject: P2X4
relationships.evidence_quote: which may be mediated by the activation of ionotropic P2X purinergic receptors P2X4 and P2X7

key_findings: Review: CB2R is upregulated in activated spinal microglia and promotes an anti-inflammatory M2 phenotype, supporting CB2R agonist analgesia without CB1R side effects.
